title: Support Engineer, PAYGO
description:
Headquarters:

 URL: https://exa.ai/

 About Exa
 We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.
 Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike.
 We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

 About the Role
 Thousands of developers and companies use Exa on pay-as-you-go. As the Support Engineer for PAYGO, you own all of their inbound questions: getting started, search quality, billing, errors, integrations, and real bugs. The volume is high and every day is different.
 It's one of the fastest ways to learn Exa end to end. You'll work with our AI support tools, the docs, Product and Engineering, and you'll see what developers build with Exa before anyone else does. Some of the people writing in are tomorrow's biggest customers, and you'll be the one who spots them.

 In this role, you will:
 • Own the PAYGO queue : answer what the AI first line can't, quickly and clearly

• Debug with customers : reproduce issues with the API, read their code and send working fixes

• Triage well : production issues and unhappy customers first, everything else in order

• Escalate with full context : bugs to Engineering, product gaps to Product, and anything you can't resolve to the Support leader

• Spot growth : flag PAYGO accounts that look like future enterprise customers to Sales

• Improve the AI first line : fix the docs, help center and agent workflows so the same question doesn't need a human twice

• Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback

 Requirements
 • Programming experience: you can read unfamiliar code, call an API and debug a failing request

• Clear, short writing. Customers can act on your answers without coming back

• You learn fast and keep quality high when the volume is high

• Good judgment on what to answer yourself and what to escalate

• Comfort working AI-first, with AI tools and agents as part of your daily workflow

• Early-career candidates are welcome

 You might excel if you...
 • Have worked in support, developer relations or a customer-facing technical role at a developer-tools, API or AI company

• Have built side projects with LLMs, RAG or agents

• Enjoy being the person who finally figures out what's going on

• Want to grow into an FDE or Solutions Architect role over time

• Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

 This is a remote role based in the US. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.
 Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Autonomous Systems Security Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote-Friendly (Travel Required) | San Francisco, CA

 About Anthropic

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the role

 Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. You'll be the engineer who owns autonomous systems across that footprint as one security domain, from both sides: drones, ground robots and automated vehicles for patrol, inspection and moving hardware, including the security of that automation inside secure areas, and the detection systems that tell us what is flying over or operating near a site uninvited.

 You set the approach, select and integrate the platforms and sensors, write the requirements vendors build to, and run what you ship, from the operating model where operators assign missions and machines carry them out to the playbook that turns a detection into an identified track and a well-evidenced handoff to whoever holds authority over the airspace. Interdiction is not part of this role. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, fleet health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

 You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations and legal teams, and directly with site operators, equipment vendors and aviation and public safety authorities. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

 Key responsibilities

•
 Autonomous security and inspection systems: own the drones, ground robots and other autonomous platforms for perimeter patrol, incident response and infrastructure inspection: platform selection, operating model, operator qualification, maintenance, and the data path from machine to analyst

•
 Tools, automation and AI agents: build the integrations that carry detections, tracks, telemetry and fleet health into the team's security monitoring platform, and the tools and agents that triage detections, check fleet health and assemble evidence. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it

•
 Detection of uncrewed systems: engineer the sensing that tells us what is flying over or operating near a site, what it is and who needs to know: sensor selection and evaluation against live targets, per-site coverage, classification and false-alarm handling, and the playbook from first detection to handoff, with evidence retained

•
 Security of site automation: engineer the controls on automated vehicles, robots and similar machines that move hardware or work inside secure areas: identity and access, network isolation, what they may record and where it goes, fail-secure behavior, their place in chain of custody, and acceptance before they enter a site

•
 Regulatory and site constraints: establish what we may sense, fly, drive, record and retain at each site, partner-operated sites included, under the aviation, spectrum, privacy and safety rules that apply there, with the waivers and approvals that extend it and coordination with local authorities set up before it is needed

•
 Health monitoring: define and test heartbeats, loss-of-coverage and lost-link alarms and fail-secure behavior, so a silent sensor or machine shows as a fault, not a quiet day

•
 Vendor requirements and acceptance: write the requirements, evaluate against live flights and runs, and hold vendors to what they ship

 Minimum qualifications

•
 Have engineered autonomous or sensing systems in the field (drones, ground robots, automated vehicles, or RF, radar or optical detection sensors): selected, integrated or secured them for an operation other people relied on, and verified what they actually do against real targets or runs rather than a datasheet

•
 Have integrated systems you did not build (vendor APIs, SDKs, appliances, machine and sensor telemetry) into a platform that outlives any one of them

•
 Read and review code, design the data systems behind security tooling, and build automation (often with AI coding agents) using Git and code review

•
 Have done this work hands-on for data centers, critical infrastructure or a large hardware fleet

•
 Have designed inside a regulatory or safety constraint (aviation, spectrum, privacy, machine safety or similar) and can show the decision it drove

•
 Own a domain end to end: set the approach, carry it through with vendors, site operators, partners and authorities, and run it as something people depend on every day

 Preferred qualifications

•
 Remote pilot certification (for example FAA Part 107) and experience flying beyond visual line of sight under a waiver or exemption

•
 Experience with counter-drone (counter-UAS) detection, airspace surveillance or air traffic data systems

•
 Experience running a robot, drone or automated-vehicle fleet in an industrial, logistics or data center setting: fleet management, mission planning, safety cases

•
 Experience securing embedded, operational technology or robotic systems: device identity, network segmentation, update control, logging

•
 Experience with physical security operations at large sites, with law enforcement or aviation authorities, or at sites you did not fully control: cloud, colocation or GPU cloud operators

•
 Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual work

 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

 Annual Salary:
 $320,000 — $405,000 USD

 Logistics

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different

 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us!

 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/anthropic-autonomous-systems-security-engineer

title: Nurse Practitioner - Arizona (AZ) License - Remote
description:
Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona, United States

 URL: https://www.joinmidi.com

 You built your career caring for women at a time when the healthcare system largely ignored them. You know HRT, you understand the complexity of perimenopause, and you’ve spent years earning the clinical instincts it takes to actually get this right. Now you want to do it at scale — for more patients, with fewer barriers, and in a practice model that matches how you already think and work.

 That’s what Midi is. A fully virtual, fast-paced clinical environment built specifically around women’s midlife health — and designed for NPs who are ready to practice at their best.

 THE ROLE

 You’ll carry a full patient panel, managing perimenopause, menopause, weight, sexual health, mood, and sleep — all virtually. This is ongoing, relationship-based care, which means your patients come back to you — visit after visit, over months and years. You’ll prescribe and independently manage HRT (estrogen, progesterone, testosterone), evaluate patients for pharmacologic weight management including GLP-1 therapies, and make autonomous clinical decisions every day.

 It’s a high-volume environment. Documentation, follow-through, and productivity benchmarks are part of the job — and the NPs who thrive here don’t fight that reality, they’re built for it. If you’re the kind of clinician who runs efficient visits without sacrificing warmth, closes every loop without being reminded, and moves comfortably between patients and platforms, you’ll feel at home here.

 WHO THRIVES HERE

 Our most successful NPs tend to share a few things in common:

• They are genuinely passionate about women’s midlife health — this isn’t a stopover, it’s their calling

• They are fluent with technology — EHR, video, AI scribe tools, Slack, clinical decision support — and they adapt quickly when tools change

• They hold themselves to a high standard without needing to be managed toward it

• They can carry a full panel, hit productivity targets, and still make every patient feel like the only one

• They’ve practiced independently long enough to trust their own clinical judgment

• They believe that listening deeply and documenting accurately are both forms of excellent care

 QUALIFICATIONS

 What you'll need

 Active board certification: FNP-C / FNP-BC or WHNP-BC Active NP license (DEA preferred) and willingness to obtain additional state licenses 3+ years of experience practicing as a Nurse Practitioner Experience independently managing your own patients Comfort providing care via telemedicine Expert level technical proficiency and adaptability to new technologies

 What helps

 Experience in any of these is a plus:

• Perimenopause and menopause care, including HRT

• Weight management, including GLP-1s

• Managing an ongoing patient panel

• Telemedicine

• Certification in Menopause (MSCP) and/or Obesity Medicine

 Our ideal candidate

 Our strongest candidates typically bring 3+ years of experience across menopause care, HRT, panel management, and telemedicine, plus 1+ year in pharmacologic weight management.

 If that's not you, we still want to hear from you.

 Details

 Employer: Integrated Women’s Care (IWC)
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 FLSA Status: Exempt
 Compensation: $55 - $75 / hour, based on geographic location
 Reports To: Nurse Practitioner Manager
 Work Location: Remote — work must be completed within the United States
 Schedule: Between 7:00 am – 7:00 pm, patient local timezone

 At this time, Midi is unable to provide visa sponsorship. All Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship needs.

 Please note that all official communication from Midi Health will come from an @joinmidi.com email address. We will never ask for payment of any kind during the application or hiring process. If you receive any suspicious communication claiming to be from Midi Health, please report it immediately by emailing us at careers@joinmidi.com .

 Midi Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to pay equity and ensure that all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. Our compensation philosophy is based on fair, objective criteria and the impact of the role, regardless of an applicant’s salary history.

 Please find our CCPA Privacy Notice for California Candidates here .

title: Head of Finance
description:
Headquarters:

 URL: https://www.goethena.com

 Who we are

 We’re Ethena, an AI platform that’s revolutionizing the Compliance space. Our team of agents helps Compliance leaders run proactive Compliance programs that drive meaningful behavior change.

 From Policies and Disclosures to Training, Hotline, and Analytics, our agents work together to drive smarter, faster, human-led decision-making. Hotline and training data rolls up into fully customizable, board-ready risk reports. Phishing clicks trigger bite-sized, targeted follow-up courses that drive behavior change without taking up a ton of training time. Our AI call taker synthesizes data to recommend improvements to company policies and training. Every signal lands in one place, so Compliance leaders can spot risk early and fix it before it becomes a problem. The agents do the legwork, and people make every judgment call.

 More than 2,000 organizations, from Pinterest and Zendesk to the Salvation Army, run their programs on Ethena. That covers millions of employees, from the warehouse floor to the trading desk. Our learning paths drop seat time by 60%, learners give our training a 93% approval rating, and 96% of customers renew.

 Lots of companies call themselves AI-forward. We’ve actually built the tools to prove it. Come help us build what’s next.

 How we work

 We’re a team that values diversity in all its forms and loves adding new perspectives. We ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and build with empathy — for customers and each other. We're passionate about the work we do, love feedback, and lead with high agency and accountability. When we see something that could be better, we step up to the plate and do something about it. We take our work seriously, but are careful not to take ourselves too seriously. Because doing great work should be fun.

 Our workforce is fully remote, and your personal working hours can be based on your own timezone. All team-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of all North American time zones.

 Who we're looking for

 Ethena is growing fast, and we need a finance leader who’s excited to build what comes next. As our Head of Finance, you’ll own the full finance function, from accounting and close to forecasting, planning, and board reporting. You’ll report to our COO and work closely with them to give our leadership team the data and insight behind our biggest decisions. You’ll also give every department head a clear line of sight into their budget. We’re looking for someone with a real point of view. You’ll spot the risks and opportunities in the numbers before anyone asks and turn complex data into clear and actionable takeaways. You’ll be hands-on in the details one day and zoomed out on strategy the next. Along the way, you’ll build a high-performing finance team that holds itself to a high bar.

 What you’ll do

• Partner with the COO to drive smart decisions. You’ll keep leadership equipped with a clear, current view of financials, forecasts, and runway. You’ll also pull together and synthesize the data behind our biggest calls. You’ll flag risks and opportunities early, lay out the levers we can pull, and bring a recommendation on things like a smarter way to deploy spend or a cost that’s growing faster than its value. Then you’ll turn it into takeaways the exec team can act on.

• Partner with RevOps on revenue and comp plans. You’ll work with our Head of RevOps to turn pipeline and attainment data into financial insight on unit economics, retention, and sales efficiency. You’ll oversee commission and comp plans.

• Give every department head line of sight. You’ll work with each leader so they always know where their budget stands, what’s changed, and what tradeoffs they’re facing.

• Own planning and forecasting. That covers the annual plan, quarterly reforecasts, the operating model, the cash forecast, and scenario planning for pricing, hiring, and growth.

• Oversee accounting end to end. You’ll oversee month-end and year-end close, AR/AP, revenue recognition, and tax, and build a faster, cleaner close as we scale.

• Lead the audit and keep us compliant. You’ll own the annual audit and keep us current on tax and regulatory requirements everywhere we operate.

• Manage investor and lender relationships. You’ll own board and investor reporting, manage our banking and lending partners, and lead fundraising work from model to data room.

• Level up the finance function. You’ll grow and lead the team, decide what to bring in-house versus outsource, and use AI and automation to keep a lean team operating well above its size.

 What you'll bring

• You cut your teeth in FP&A and have since overseen every part of finance, including accounting, at early stage and fast-growing SaaS companies.

• You’ve built and led a finance team, and you’ve been the person accountable for the numbers, not just a contributor to them.

• You’ve run an audit, supported a fundraise, and presented directly to a board.

• You’re as comfortable reconciling an account as you are presenting a growth plan to the board.

• You have a strong point of view and share it. You come with a recommendation and the math behind it, and you change your mind when the data says you should.

• You can make finance make sense to anyone, from a first-time manager to a board member.

• You’re highly autonomous and do your best work when you’re trusted to run your function.

• You care about building a team with a culture of excellence, and you know how to hire, coach, and raise the bar.

• You’re AI-native. You already use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to automate work, build models, and get to insights faster, and you’d rather build a tool than hire for a task.

• You thrive on a fully distributed team, and move fast without losing rigor.

 \n

\n $200,000 - $250,000 a year
\n At Ethena, we're committed to fair and equitable compensation. We carefully evaluate each candidate's skills and qualifications to provide our best possible offer upfront. Our no-negotiation policy ensures that our first offer is always our best offer , promoting pay equity throughout our organization.

 Physical Demands

 This is sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing in a home office environment.

 Location

 Ethena is a remote-first organization and is currently hiring candidates based in the United States.

 We are not currently offering employer visa sponsorship for this role.

 AI Usage in Interviews:

 We’re big fans of AI and use it heavily in our day-to-day work. That said, to ensure fairness and accurate skill assessment, we do not allow the use of AI tools (including note takers, transcription tools, or recordings) during interviews. If you have questions or need accommodations, we’re happy to chat — just let us know.

 Benefits

 The benefits offered for this position can be found here . We provide unlimited PTO.

 How to Apply

 Applications for this position will be accepted via our job board . Excited about the opportunity, but worried you don’t meet all the requirements? Apply anyway, and give us both the chance to find out. We welcome you to read more about our approach to job descriptions by our Chief People Officer, Melanie Naranjo. Curious to know what it’s like to interview with us? Read more here .

 Ethena is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a successful organization is one that celebrates its employees for who they are, who they love, and the unique lens through which they experience the world. Ethena does not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or other legally protected status. We understand that our differences make us better. They empower us to learn from each other, lean on each other, and create a product and community that models the behavior we hope to see in others.

 Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information are accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

description:
Job Title: Sports Assistant 

Hourly Rate: £13.45 (Grade Aii) 

Contract Type: Casual 

Additional information: This is a casual position, with working hours offered on an as-required basis. Typical operating hours are weekday evenings from 4:30pm to 10:30pm and weekends from 8:30am to 7:00pm. 

Start Date: January 2027 (Subject to completion of pre-employment checks) 

Your opportunity to support community sport and deliver excellent customer service 

We are seeking enthusiastic, reliable and customer-focused individuals to join our team as a Casual Sports Assistant at City Academy Bristol. In this varied and rewarding role, you will help ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of our sports facilities, providing a safe, welcoming and positive experience for academy users, community groups and hirers. 

Working as part of a supportive team, you will assist with the setup and dismantling of sports equipment, supervise facility users, maintain high standards of cleanliness and safety, and support the successful delivery of sporting activities and events. You will play an important role in ensuring our facilities are well-presented, secure and ready for use, while delivering excellent customer service at all times. 

About you 

You will have: 

  • An awareness of health, safety, security, confidentiality and data protection procedures. 
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and effectively with a wide range of users and visitors. 
  • The ability to work well as part of a team while also using your own initiative and working with minimal supervision. 
  • The confidence to make sound decisions, deal appropriately with challenging situations and respond calmly to incidents or inappropriate behaviour. 
  • A commitment to maintaining high standards across our sports facilities, including equipment checks, housekeeping and site security. 
  • An appropriate first aid qualification, or the willingness to undertake training where required. 
  • A commitment to safeguarding, equality, diversity and promoting the wellbeing of children and young people. 
  • Previous experience working within a sports, leisure or educational environment would be advantageous but is not essential. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification prior to submitting an application. 

About City Academy Bristol:  

City Academy Bristol is a vibrant, diverse and dynamic academy in the centre of Bristol. We provide an inclusive and accessible education, which transforms future opportunities for young people, their families and the community.   

We are a well-positioned and well-connected academy with direct connections to local trains and buses.  

Why work at CLF?    

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters. Over 73% of the students who attend City Academy Bristol are from global majority groups, so we particularly encourage applicants from those groups in order to represent the students we serve, as well as wider underrepresented groups including gender, transgender, age disability, sexual orientation or religion.  

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS). 
  • Generous annual leave. 
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay. 
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more! 

Recruitment timeline: 

  • Closing Date: 22 November 2026 @11.59pm 
  • Shortlisting: 23 November 2026 
  • Interviews: 26/27 November 2026 

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment. 

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form. 

Please note we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. 

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out.  

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

Hours: Part-time, 11 hours per week Term Time Only plus INSET Days. 

Provisional Start Date: January 2027 

An exciting opportunity for an Administrator to gain further skills 

We are looking for a SEN Administrator to provide highly effective and efficient administrative support to the SENDCo and SEND team to ensure the school provides excellent education for all students with SEND.  

Under the direction of the SENCO, the Administration Assistant will provide general administrative and clerical support to the SEN Department within the academy. They will be expected to undertake administrative tasks such as dealing with incoming and outgoing mail, processing or completing SEND specific paperwork or liaising with families. 

This is a varied and busy role and will require the postholder to have sound organisation skills and be a confident communicator as liaison will include senior leaders, parents, students and external agencies. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application. 

About King’s Oak Academy: 

King’s Oak Academy is situated in the heart of the South Gloucestershire community and is within easy commuting distance of Bristol and Bath. The academy has been part of the Cabot Learning Federation since 2011 and enjoys the benefits of being part of a mature, successful multi-academy trust, offering access to high-quality professional services and opportunities to work collaboratively with experienced colleagues across the trust.  

As an all-through school, King’s Oak is in a privileged position to educate children aged 4–16 and to support families over time. The academy has 228 children in Reception-Year 6 and 662 in Year 7-11. The school is structured into phases that ensures that learning is high quality and responsive to pupils’ developmental needs and long-term relationships are fostered with families. As a result, colleagues benefit from the distinctive professional development and leadership opportunities that come from working in an all-through community school.  

King’s Oak was inspected in June 2025 and secured an ‘Outstanding’ judgement in both Leadership and Management and Personal Development. Inspectors noted that “pupils thrive at King’s Oak Academy. The school expects them to ‘work hard, be kind’, and pupils strive to do this. There are high expectations of what pupils can achieve academically and of who they can become.” King’s Oak Academy is therefore an ambitious, values-led community in which staff are trusted, developed and supported to do their best work and where colleagues who share our commitment to high expectations, kindness and inclusive excellence can build a rewarding and sustained career. 

 Why work at CLF? 

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters. We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS). 
  • Generous annual leave. 
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay. 

Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more! 

Recruitment timeline: 

Closing Date: 22 November 2026 

Interviews: 30 November 2026 

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment. 

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs, a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form. 

Please note we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. 

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out. 

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

title: Backend / Platform Developer Consultant (Temporal & Kubernetes)
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://bitovi.com

 JOIN OUR TEAM!

 Bitovi is looking for a Backend / Platform Developer Consultant to join us as we transform technology delivery. We build and operate durable, distributed systems for enterprise clients — heavy on Java Services, Temporal for workflow orchestration, Kafka for event streaming, and Kubernetes-native platform engineering on AWS to run it all reliably. If you want to build exceptional systems, take orchestration, systems engineering, and infrastructure seriously, and have ideas for making delivery more collaborative, validation-driven, and swift, we want to work with you!

 Compensation: $120,000 to $190,000 annually, depending on experience, plus annual bonus opportunity.

 PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only considering candidates located in and authorized to work in the United States.

 WHO YOU ARE

 You're experienced building and running applications at the enterprise level, and you're comfortable owning both the code and the infrastructure it runs on. You think like a systems engineer — reasoning about the whole platform, from JVM services and event streams to the clusters and cloud infrastructure underneath them. You thrive when given opportunities to deliver real-world platforms as an integral team member, including large-scale migrations, and you have the expertise to interface and communicate confidently with stakeholders.

 You'll excel in this role at Bitovi if you have:

• Strong working knowledge of Java and the JVM ecosystem (Spring Boot or similar); experience with additional backend languages (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, etc.) is a plus

• Hands-on experience with a durable execution / workflow engine — Temporal preferred (Apache Airflow, Prefect, or similar also relevant) — including modeling workflows and activities, handling retries and timeouts, and reasoning about idempotency and failure modes

• Experience designing and operating Kafka-based event streaming systems: topic and partition design, consumer groups, schema management, and reasoning about ordering, delivery guarantees, and consumer lag

• Experience designing and building GraphQL APIs — schema design, resolvers, and performance concerns (N+1, caching, pagination); federation experience a plus

• Deep, hands-on AWS experience: architecting, deploying, and operating production systems (EKS, networking, IAM, messaging, and data services)

• Solid Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and debugging production workloads

• A systems engineering mindset: understanding of complex scaling issues, concurrency, backpressure, caching strategies, and failure modes across distributed systems

• Experience planning and executing migrations — application replatforming, workflow engine migrations, data/schema migrations, or moving workloads between environments with minimal downtime

• A thorough understanding of CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-style delivery

• Experience with observability in practice — logging, metrics, and tracing (OpenTelemetry a plus)

• Experience building modern microservice-based or serverless applications

• Database schema design and development expertise

 Other skills we value

 Temporal depth

• Running Temporal in production — self-hosted on Kubernetes and/or Temporal Cloud

• Workflow versioning and patching, safe deployments, and long-running workflow migrations

• Worker deployment and tuning (pollers, task queues, concurrency/slot configuration)

• Namespace management, mTLS (SPIFFE/SPIRE or private CA), and capacity/scaling concerns (e.g. APS/TRU on Temporal Cloud

 Kafka & event streaming depth

• Operating Kafka in production (MSK, Confluent, or self-managed on Kubernetes)

• Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, and schema registry workflows (Avro/Protobuf)

• Migrating between clusters or providers, and integrating Kafka with downstream analytical stores

• Experience with different techniques for processing large datasets, such as Lambda and Kappa architectures

 Platform / DevOps depth

• Building or operating an internal developer platform (IDP) — self-service, paved-path infrastructure for application teams

• GitOps with ArgoCD (or Flux) and a low- or zero-manual-apply delivery model

• Infrastructure as code: Terraform/OpenTofu, and provisioning AWS resources via Crossplane, ACK, or similar

• Writing Kubernetes controllers/operators (controller-runtime, kubebuilder) and working with CRDs

• Helm chart authoring and distribution (including OCI/registry-based)

• Secrets management (External Secrets Operator, etc.), autoscaling (Karpenter, KEDA), and service mesh concepts (Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE)

• EKS or comparable managed Kubernetes at scale

 General

• Interest in working across multiple backend languages

• Additional queueing and messaging technologies (AWS SQS/SNS, RabbitMQ)

• API design across paradigms (GraphQL, REST, gRPC)

• AuthN/AuthZ and related technologies (sessions, API tokens, JWTs)

• Automated testing across the stack (unit, integration, performance/benchmarking)

 WHO WE ARE

 Bitovi partners with companies to build outcome-focused apps and platforms. Our collaborative approach is driven by validation to deliver the swiftest route to the most valuable solution.

 We design and build high-profile applications and the infrastructure behind them — with tests, full docs, and a real deployment process. We run a serious Temporal practice (including large-scale migration and security work for enterprise clients) alongside deep Kubernetes, AWS, and platform engineering work. We discuss and design architectures, review code, and research new technologies. We talk to our clients, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

 We help one another freely. We keep a Slack channel called ask-help, which is constantly used. We develop new skills, build better developer tools, and work on new types of projects regularly.

 Our fully remote team comprises about 70 developers and designers. We welcome diversity and non-traditional paths into professions — we want the right person, not the right collection of tech keywords.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO AT BITOVI

 Build durable systems. Design and implement Java services, Temporal workflows, and Kafka-based event pipelines, and help clients adopt durable execution and event streaming the right way — from first workflow to production scale.

 Lead modernization efforts. Plan and execute large-scale modernization efforts — moving workflows, services, and data between platforms, clusters, and clouds — with safety, observability, and minimal disruption as first-class requirements.

 Own the platform. Build and operate Kubernetes-native infrastructure and CI/CD on AWS so application teams can ship safely and quickly. Treat reliability, observability, and repeatability as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought.

 Consult and manage. Consult with clients to build outcome-driven applications and platforms, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

 Travel. This is a remote, full-time position that requires the ability to travel. We travel an average of 3–5 days every quarter, and we'll always do our best to work with your schedule.

 Teach. We'll discuss opportunities for you to present at conferences, attend and give training, plan and run meetups or local groups, and create various kinds of content in your area of expertise.

 BENEFITS WE OFFER

• Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunity

• Completely remote work with flexible hours

• 401(k) matching

• 4 weeks of paid time off in addition to 8 paid holidays

• Health, dental, and vision insurance offerings

• Paid maternity and paternity leave

• STD, LTD, and Life Insurance coverage

 HOW TO APPLY

 Please share a resume or LinkedIn profile and answer the additional questions via the application link.

 OTHER

 Please note that we are not interested in working with recruiters.

 ID Verification required if invited to an interview.

 All job offers are contingent on passing a background check.

 Candidates must be located in and authorized to work in the United States; we are unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitovi-backend-platform-developer-consultant-temporal-kubernetes

title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote • Canada

 About Upsun

 Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

 Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

• Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.

• Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:

• Predictable performance, even at scale

• Secure, compliant environments by default

• Real-time observability and profiling built in

• Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds

• Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

 The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

 What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

 Our values:

 We make a positive impact.

 We aim for the stars.

 We care for each other.

 Impact of a Senior IT Systems Engineer

 As a Senior IT Engineer, you help shape and improve the systems that our 250+ person remote company relies on every day. Your work spans identity and access, Google Workspace, device management, and our wider SaaS environment.
 Reporting to the IT Director, you take ownership of complex problems and lead improvements from initial assessment through delivery. You identify what needs attention, recommend priorities, and make thoughtful decisions that balance security, reliability, and employee experience. You also help the team build stronger practices through clear documentation, shared knowledge, and practical guidance.

 What to expect

•
 Identity platform: Improve our identity and access services, with Okta at the core. This includes single sign-on, automated account provisioning, multi-factor authentication, access policies, and emergency access. Work with IT and Security to make access secure, consistent, and straightforward.

•
 Google Workspace: Lead the administration and improvement of our Google Workspace environment, including users, groups, Gmail, Drive, shared drives, and security settings. Improve how people collaborate, manage sharing and access, and keep our configuration aligned with business needs.

•
 Device management: Help lead the rollout and ongoing development of JumpCloud and our device management practices across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Define and implement device configurations, security policies, software deployment, and onboarding processes in partnership with IT Operations and Security.

•
 Automation and employee lifecycle: Design and improve onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across identity, devices, and SaaS tools. Use tools such as Okta Workflows, n8n, Python, and APIs to reduce manual work and make processes more reliable.

•
 Continuous improvement: Assess our current systems, identify gaps, and turn findings into practical improvements. Investigate complex issues across connected services, address root causes, and follow through until changes are working well.

•
 SaaS administration and governance: Administer our core internal tools and help evaluate new applications. Establish clear practices for application setup, integrations, access requests, approvals, and access reviews.

•
 Security and compliance: Partner with Security and the Risk and Audit team to implement and maintain controls across identity, Google Workspace, devices, and SaaS tools. Automate evidence collection where practical to support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2.

•
 Project delivery and mentoring: Lead projects from scoping and technical design through rollout and handover. Coordinate dependencies, communicate risks and progress, and help colleagues grow through documentation, reviews, and knowledge sharing.

 What you bring

•
 Broad IT engineering experience: You have hands-on experience across identity, collaboration tools, endpoint management, and SaaS administration. You understand how these systems connect and can troubleshoot problems across them.

• Depth in a core area: You bring strong expertise in at least one of Okta, Google Workspace, or JumpCloud, along with the ability to work across the others. We welcome different strengths; you do not need to be equally expert in all three.

•
 Device management deployment: You have helped deploy or significantly improve an MDM or endpoint management platform. You can turn security and operational requirements into workable configurations, test them, and roll them out with minimal disruption.

•
 Automation and scripting: You build reliable automation using workflow tools, APIs, webhooks, and Python or a comparable scripting language. You consider error handling, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

•
 A track record of improvement: You can share examples of systems or processes you assessed, improved, and delivered, with clear results for employees or the IT team.

•
 Proactive judgment and ownership: You work independently, make sound technical decisions, and know when to involve others. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, explain trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome.

•
 Security and compliance awareness: You have implemented controls such as access reviews, secure configurations, or device policies, and understand how to document and demonstrate that they work. Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 is valuable.

•
 Clear communication and collaboration: You work effectively in a fully remote team and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues across cultures. You share knowledge and help others become more effective.

•
 Experience: Typically six or more years in IT engineering, systems administration, identity, or endpoint management, with increasing responsibility for technical decisions and project delivery. Equivalent experience matters more than a specific number of years.

 Bonus points

•
 Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including assessing and integrating identity systems, Google Workspace environments, devices, or SaaS tools.

•
 Experience in a developer-heavy or engineering-led company.

•
 Experience supporting both ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2, including automated evidence collection.

•
 Professional proficiency in French.

 Where we hire

 At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans more than 30 countries and a wide range of experience levels, and we’re currently hiring for this role in Canada . We’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, but we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

 How we hire

 Our interview process is a chance for us to understand how you think, what you’ve built, and what you want to take on next, and for you to get to know us. Together, we’ll explore where your strengths and interests meet the challenges our teams are solving.

 We know a great hire won’t meet every requirement above. If you can see yourself making the team better, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here if someone hadn’t taken a chance on us.

 You can expect 4 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below.

• 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition

• 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, IT)

• 60 Minutes with Team (Senior Director, Site Reliability Engineering, Senior IT Manager)

• 45 Minutes with Executive (Senior Director, FP&A & IT)

 All roles require background checks.

 What we offer

 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp .

 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

 ️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

 Flexible PTO

 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain)

 Company stock options

 Professional development budget

 Office equipment budget

 ‍️ Wellness budget

 Annual team gatherings

 Inclusive parental leave

 ️ Remote work travel program

 You belong here

 At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upsun-senior-it-systems-engineer

title: VRO Lead
description:
Headquarters: Dallas, Texas, United States

 URL: https://kyndryl.com

 Who We Are
 At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

 The Role
 In the Value Realization Office at Kyndryl, you will play a critical role in ensuring that our customers achieve and maximize the tangible business outcomes promised in their digital transformation journeys. You will act as the strategic driver behind establishing, measuring, and protecting value across complex IT outsourcing, enterprise resource planning (ERP), and large-scale infrastructure engagements post-contract signature.

 In this role, you will define and execute the VRO operating model from the ground up, establishing governance cadences, RACI frameworks, and executive escalation paths tailored to each engagement. You will partner closely with client finance and operations leaders to rigorously construct and validate operational baselines, translating overarching deal cases into transparent, actionable benefits registers equipped with defined KPIs, milestones, and auditable proof points.

 Your financial acumen and analytical rigor will be central to defining robust measurement models for hard cost savings, risk and cost avoidance, productivity uplift, and service quality enhancements. By designing automated scorecards and dashboards, tracking realized gains, and diagnosing root causes behind value leakage or process drift, you will keep critical customer engagements on course. Furthermore, you will lead high-impact value reviews with C-suite stakeholders and Kyndryl account executives, turning proven realized value into a catalyst for account renewals, expansion, and long-term client advocacy.

 Key Responsibilities
 • VRO Governance & Operating Model: Establish and lead the VRO governance framework across major IT outsourcing and transformation accounts, including meeting cadences, RACI matrices, roles, and escalation workflows.
• Baseline Validation & Benefits Architecture: Partner directly with client finance and operational teams to construct baseline metrics; convert complex deal value propositions into operational benefits registers with designated owners, timing, and verifiable evidence standards.
• Value Modeling & Auditable Tracking: Define rigorous measurement methodologies for hard savings, cost avoidance, operational productivity, and service quality; maintain financial models (TCO, ROI, payback periods) and establish auditable evidence trails for formal sign-offs.
• Executive Reviews & Leakage Mitigation: Facilitate monthly and quarterly value realization reviews with C-level client executives and Kyndryl leadership; identify root causes of value leakage (e.g., scope creep, process drift, delayed adoption) and enforce recovery action plans.
• Analytics & Tooling: Build dynamic value dashboards and scorecards using Power BI or equivalent platforms to deliver single-pane visibility into target versus realized gains.
• Cross-Functional Synergy & Practice Growth: Collaborate with delivery and Organizational Change Management (OCM) leads to tie workforce adoption metrics to benefit realization; coach VRO analysts and package frameworks into standardized practice IP.

 Your Future at Kyndryl
 Kyndryl’s mission to modernize enterprise IT and drive business transformation means that within the Value Realization Office, you will be positioned at the vital intersection of technology, finance, and client strategy. You will lead high-profile transformation initiatives, mentor and direct VRO analysts across concurrent engagements, and actively contribute to building reusable assets, benchmark repositories, and measurement standards that scale across our global practice.

 Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

 Who You Are
 You are good at what you do and possess the proven consulting and financial depth to prove it. You bring a growth mindset, navigating complex transformation headwinds with clarity and decisive problem-solving. You are relentlessly customer-focused—committed to ensuring our clients see verifiable return on investment and financial transparency. Finally, you are empathetic, collaborative, and borderless, partnering seamlessly across organizational change management (OCM), delivery, and executive teams to build trust and achieve shared success.

 Qualifications
 • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field. MBA preferred.
• 12+ years in consulting, transformation, or managed services, with at least 5 years leading benefits realization, value management, or financial tracking on large engagements.
• Proven experience building baselines, KPI frameworks, and benefits registers that have held up under client finance scrutiny.
• Strong financial modeling skills covering TCO, ROI, and payback, with working knowledge of IT outsourcing commercial structures.
• Track record presenting value results to client executives and managing difficult conversations about shortfalls.
• Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt preferred.

 The base compensation range for the position in the U.S. is -
 $143,640 to $273,000 based on a full-time schedule reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Kyndryl, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting.

 Your actual compensation may vary depending on multiple factors legally permitted in the applicable jurisdiction, including, but not limited to, geography, relevant job-related skills, education and experience, certification and licenses, internal pay equity, and market and business consideration. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.

 There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations:
 California (San Francisco Bay Area): $172,440 to $327,600
 California (All Other): $158,040 to $300,360
 Colorado: $143,640 to $273,000
 Massachusetts/ Virginia: $143,640 to $300,360
 New York City: $172,440 to $327,600
 Washington: $158,040 to $300,360
 Washington DC: $158,040 to $300,360

 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.
 Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

 Being You
 Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

 What You Can Expect
 With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

 Get Referred!
 If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyndryl-vro-lead

description:
Headquarters: Alabama, United States

 URL: https://www.sedgwick.com

 By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

 Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies
 Certified as a Great Place to Work®
 Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

Liability Claims Associate | Remote | Dedicated Client

Are you looking for an impactful job requiring no prior experience that offers an opportunity to develop a professional career?
• A stable and consistent work environment in an office setting
• Career development and promotional growth opportunities through increasing responsibilities
• A diverse and comprehensive benefits package to take care of your mental, physical, financial and professional needs

 PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THE ROLE: To analyze reported lower-level level general liability claims to determine benefits due; and to ensure ongoing adjudication of claims within company standards and industry best practices.

 ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE? We are looking for an enthusiastic candidate to fill a Workers Compensation Associate position. Ideal candidates will thrive in a collaborative team environment, show motivation and drive in their work ethic, are customer-oriented, naturally empathic and solution-focused.

 ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES MAY INCLUDE
 • Handles lower-level liability and/or physical damage claims under close supervision.
• Supports other claims representatives, examiners and leads with larger or more complex claims as necessary.
• Processes general liability claims determining compensability and benefits due; monitors reserve accuracy, and files necessary documentation with state agency.
• Communicates claim action/processing with claimant, client and appropriate medical contact.
• Ensures claim files are properly documented and claims coding is correct.
• May process routine payments and prescriptions and status reports for lifetime medical claims and/or defined period medical claims.
• Maintains professional client relationships.

 Licensing: preferred

 QUALIFICATIONS

description:

 URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/u8TybTAE2YbYgRVFYov9t4/jobs-at-proarch

 Partner Discovery & Requirements Analysis
 • Lead and document working sessions with clinical, finance, operations, product, and technical stakeholders to understand existing workflows, business rules, data requirements, and operational processes.
• Translate manual and system-supported workflows into structured business and functional requirements.
• Produce gap-analysis documentation mapping current-state processes and partner requirements to existing platform capabilities.
• Classify requirements based on appropriate disposition, such as existing functionality, configuration, new development, acceptable operational workaround, shared platform enhancement, or out of scope.
• Maintain a consistent backlog structure across implementations so requirements remain comparable, traceable, and reusable.
 System Reconciliation & Technical Analysis
 • Analyze application logic, SQL, stored procedures, configuration parameters, integrations, and data flows to understand existing system behavior.
• Determine whether business requirements can be satisfied through configuration, existing functionality, process changes, or new development.
• Validate assumptions about platform behavior against available technical evidence and distinguish confirmed system behavior from inferred behavior.
• Identify discrepancies between documented behavior, stakeholder expectations, system configuration, and implemented logic.
• Trace business rules to underlying parameters, data elements, calculations, integrations, and system components.
• Identify where behaviors are configurable versus hardcoded and assess the impact on future implementations.
 Requirements Authoring
 • Write clear business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and proposed workarounds.
• Maintain appropriate separation between business-facing requirements and technical implementation details.
• Ensure acceptance criteria reflect the agreed solution approach, including configuration changes, operational workarounds, or new functionality.
• Apply a consistent standard for distinguishing standalone requirements from assumptions, configuration decisions, implementation details, or operational procedures.
• Maintain traceability from business need through solution decision and development implementation.
 Cross-Functional Facilitation & Governance
 • Facilitate requirements, solutioning, and review sessions across business, clinical, product, engineering, data, and operational teams.
• Drive open questions toward resolution and update requirements and documentation to reflect confirmed decisions.

• Support prioritization and decision-making by clearly communicating business impact, implementation complexity, dependencies, and risk.
 Ticket Creation & Scoping
 • Translate approved requirements into development-ready tickets containing problem statements, user stories, functional scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, and open questions.

• Track dependencies across features, integrations, implementations, and shared platform capabilities.
• Identify common capabilities that can support multiple clients, workflows, or future implementations rather than creating one-off solutions.

title: CASS Oversight Manager (f/m/d)
description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

As the CASS Oversight Manager, you are responsible for ensuring that client money and custody assets held by Upvest Securities are protected, segregated and accounted for in full compliance with the FCA’s Client Assets Sourcebook (CASS).

You will act as the primary day-to-day authority on CASS, bridging the gap between complex regulatory requirements, our operational processes, our client’s needs and our scalable investment API. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Client and Operations teams to ensure our client asset framework remains robust, evidenced and audit-ready, enabling Upvest to scale its financial infrastructure to millions of end-users while maintaining the highest levels of integrity and trust with regulators, clients, and partners.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the CASS oversight framework: Maintain and continuously improve Upvest's CASS risk assessment, controls matrix, policies and procedures across CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, providing clear guidance to the business on what is and isn't permitted.

  • Work with our B2B clients, sales and client impact teams to actively shape solutions and provide advice that enables Upvest to support engaging and accessible investing for millions of end users in a CASS compliant way.

  • Oversee reconciliations and client money calculations: Oversee daily client money calculations and internal and external reconciliations of client money and custody assets, ensuring breaks are investigated promptly, shortfalls are funded and root causes are addressed.

  • Manage breaches and regulatory reporting: Maintain the CASS breach register, assess materiality, drive remediation and support FCA notifications where required. Own the monthly CMAR submission and act as the primary contact for the annual CASS audit, closing out findings to completion.

  • Keep the CASS Resolution Pack live: Ensure the resolution pack is complete, current and retrievable within regulatory timeframes, and that it is updated whenever banks, custodians, key vendors or critical staff change.

  • Embed CASS into how we build: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess the client asset impact of new products, features and system changes, and to ensure our ledgers, payment flows and custody integrations do what the rules require by design.

  • Enhance governance and culture: Produce clear CASS MI for the board and risk committees, deliver CASS training across the organisation, and track FCA developments to assess their impact on Upvest.

  • Manage external relationships: Support due diligence and periodic reviews of banks, custodians, and maintain acknowledgement letters and mandate registers in the prescribed form. Feed into TISA and other appropriate forums to gain further industry insights.

What you bring:

  • Deep CASS Expertise: Thorough working knowledge of CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, including client money calculations, reconciliation methods, acknowledgement letters, resolution pack requirements and the SMCR context in which the SMF18 operates.

  • Hands-on Client Asset Experience: Several years in a CASS operations, oversight or audit role in practice or at a broker, platform, custodian or wealth manager, with practical experience of breach handling, CMAR reporting and CASS audits.

  • Regulatory Analysis Skills: Proven experience in interpreting FCA rules and guidance and translating them into clear actionable operational procedures and controls.

  • Stakeholder Management: Strong communication of regulatory requirements to internal and external stakeholders, including engineering and product teams, external auditors and third-party custodians and banks.

  • Self-Starter Mentality: A highly organised approach with the ability to work independently, prioritise appropriately, and thrive under pressure, particularly around reporting and audit deadlines.

It’s great if you have:

  • Qualifications: Relevant industry certifications such as CISI Client Assets Specialist qualification, an accounting or audit background, or equivalent professional certification in a related discipline.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
